block_notes.1: D1: ran at the same time as the R3 screening runs and the C1/C2 microbenchmarks on other GPUs

semantics: full duplex: TTFA from the end of sending the utterance; the reply length is the model's choice; demo sampling (temperature 0.7); one session that keeps listening in 1 s units

request-response reference: TTFA from sending the whole request (a real application also waits for an end-of-speech detector, not modelled); max_tokens 64 and 'answer in one short sentence'; temperature 0; speech returns after talker and code2wav finish

both on one RTX A6000, sglang-omni 520b49ee stock; different pipelines (perception/thinker/talker/speech with FP32 flow vs thinker/talker/code2wav with FP16 flow), so a TTFA difference says nothing about any kernel or scheduling choice
